entries.zh: 陪伴；作伴同行
entries.en: company; to accompany, keep company (compañar); to join as helper if the character is 幫
entries.notes: 汉字栏'封'另疑作'幫'：第二音节合幫义而'封'字与闽南首音节不合，字证有歧。

entries.zh: 群；集合量词，一群（人或兽群）
entries.en: group, flock, crowd; collective measure word (numeral)

entries.zh: 房分；家族房支、同房之份
entries.en: branch of a family; household subdivision, companions of one house-branch

entries.zh: 与船主合夥；同船合股经营之伴
entries.en: partnership in a ship (compañía del navío); one entering into partnership with the shipmaster
entries.notes: 首字'幫'疑或作'封'，次字'癸'疑或作'發'，展开依赖推断；马尼拉船贸语境下取船主合夥义。

entries.zh: 成群；结成群体、成群结队
entries.en: in groups, to form a crowd; formed/organized company (compañia formada)

entries.zh: 群伴；同群之伴、同夥同伴
entries.en: companions of the same group; fellow members of a band

entries.zh: 一伙、小队；结群成阵的人群
entries.en: company or squad (cuadrilla); band, gang of people

entries.zh: 伴行；结伴同行
entries.en: to go or travel in company (ir en compañía); to accompany one another

entries.zh: 伴院；寺院（修道院）内之同伴、同住者
entries.en: companion in the monastery; fellow resident of the convent

entries.zh: 步兵连队；军兵、士卒
entries.en: company of foot (infantry); troops, soldiers

entries.zh: 匹配；使配成对、婚配
entries.en: to match a couple, to pair and marry off; matching

entries.zh: 一夥人；一群人
entries.en: a company or band of people; a crowd

entries.zh: 聚夥；聚集人众、纠合伙伴
entries.en: to gather companions together; to assemble, form a group (unir juntos)

entries.zh: 聚集；集合
entries.en: to gather, assemble; come together

entries.zh: 夥记（伙计）；合伙共事之人、店中伙计
entries.en: partner, associate in trade; hired clerk or shop assistant

entries.zh: 贼夥；盗贼之党、结伙的强盗
entries.en: gang or band of thieves (compañía de ladrones); band of robbers

entries.zh: 结社同夥；同盗之社党（'社'取结伙之义）
entries.en: partnership, association (communal band); companion in theft, accomplice in robbery
entries.notes: 汉字'公社'字面为公共结社，与西语 larronería（偷盗）搭配有隔，取'社＝结伙'义推断。

entries.zh: 師友；师长与朋友（同师门之友伴）
entries.en: master and companions; teachers and friends, fellow disciples

entries.zh: 同僚；同职共事之人
entries.en: colleagues; fellows in the same office or trade

entries.zh: 同伴、伙伴
entries.en: companion, partner
entries.notes: '核'无同伴本义，音读与'夥'相合，疑为'夥'之借字或形近误录。

entries.zh: 同伴、伙伴
entries.en: companion, partner
entries.notes: 首字'生'疑或作'先'，字证歧异；次字'核'同上条，疑为'夥'之借字。
